name: harness_file_ownership
description: Hand root-owned coding-agent files under the operator's home back to the operator, so `vrooli resource update` can replace them without elevating

storage.rationale: The safeguard creates no files. It changes the owner of existing coding-agent files and leaves their contents alone.

linux.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

macos.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.reason: Host safeguards mutate host state and cannot ship in a desktop bundle.

windows.evidence: Windows user installs have no root-owned file case; the agent installer writes under the user profile with the user's own ACLs.
